description: Source code implementing CPU memory allocation functions for PyTorch, including memory filling, alignment, and NUMA support.

methods.name: memset_junk
methods.description: Fills a memory region with a NaN or large integer pattern for debugging or testing.

methods.name: is_thp_alloc_enabled
methods.description: Checks if transparent huge page allocation is enabled on Linux.

methods.name: is_thp_alloc
methods.description: Determines if a large buffer should use transparent huge pages.

methods.name: c10_compute_alignment
methods.description: Computes memory alignment based on system page size and configuration.

methods.name: alloc_cpu
methods.description: Allocates aligned CPU memory with optional zero or junk filling, supports NUMA.

methods.name: free_cpu
methods.description: Frees CPU memory allocated by alloc_cpu.
